prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Original medieval RPG LOW-RES PIXEL ART character review board, plain uniform medium grey opaque background. Each row has the SAME adult character in FRONT-LEFT and BACK-RIGHT oblique full-body views. Different rows are different people, isolated without interacting. Compact stocky 40-logical-pixel-like game sprite proportions, visibly chunky square pixel clusters, selective dark outlines, restrained earthy wool/leather colors, very simple faces and folds, no painterly shading or smooth gradients. Match the previously viewed character reference in clarity but use coarser pixels. All clothing, hair, exact age and unconfirmed gender choices are NONCANONICAL appearance proposals. No labels, text, numbers, borders, insignia, modern medical symbols, modern clothes, magic, scenario or quest resolution. No implied payment, agreement, forced movement, political endorsement or relationship reconciliation. Exact grid/palette/pivots/runtime remain unverified.  Clothes should use medieval simple round-neck or tie-neck wool cuts, NOT modern lapels, tailored suit coats or collared shirts. TWO rows TWO columns. TOP SEFIN original village fisherman and local return-list copyist, adult man, proposed mature dark hair with short grey-flecked beard, dull blue simple round-neck tunic and weathered brown fisherman vest, patched trousers, boots, a small closed blank tally folio at belt, hands empty. BOTTOM BEVI his adult younger sister and returning household member who cared for their mother elsewhere, dark hair in loose practical bun, muted plum dress with brown shawl, one CLOSED worn travel satchel held herself, firm composed posture. No room allocation, forced eviction, signing repair labor, historical absolution, or brother deciding her residence. Mother remains offscreen, no inference of her present health or life status.
